main_integration_review.scope: Main independently checked every recorded term/page, cue and keyword location within actual chapter regions, plus resolved reuse references. Actual mixed-column boundaries74/81/86 inspected. Raster QRS Complex, P Wave, Atrial Pace and Ventricular Pace labels on78/79 visually checked, not claimed extractable text. Author-pending notes below are historical and superseded. AI review only, not clinical, credentialed-human, recall or rendering validation.
main_integration_review.normalizations: Case/wrap/punctuation and explicit lexical selections, not whole clinical propositions. Figure-label aliases and source device-name variants do not establish clinical equivalence. Pericardial partial-name family omits procedure/effusion suffixes and requires taught context.

keyword_screen.method: Visual inspection of all PDF74-81 page rasters plus PyMuPDF font spans and coordinates within true chapter regions. BlackSemiCn chapter/section titles, SemiboldCond subheads and table titles, MyriadPro-Bold malfunction subheads and MinionPro-Bold body passages distinguished from Cond regular table cells and regular captions. Lexical headwords selected from clauses without importing instructions. Bounded scan completed across headings, Tables33-1 through33-7 and Figures33-1 through33-5. Raster-only waveform labels visually inspected; no ECG criteria imported. Headwords from bold sentences mapped separately from statements. Not every regular body word or plot label.
